text: FlyHouse is a private aviation company (FlyHouse Management, LLC) founded and chaired by Sanford Michelman, co-founding partner of the law firm Michelman & Robinson.
short: FlyHouse is a private aviation company founded and chaired by Sanford Michelman.

source.name: Michelman & Robinson: Sanford L. Michelman, Co-Founding Partner (attorney profile)
source.quote: He founded and is Chairman of FlyHouse, a private aviation company powered by dynamic proprietary pricing technology.
